people.name: Beriah
people.line: Levite in the time of David

people.name: Jahath
people.line: Levite, descendant of Shimei, son of Gershon.

people.name: Jeush
people.line: A Levite, son of Shimei or Shubael

people.name: Shimei
people.line: Son of Gershon and grandson of Levi.

translations.web: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
translations.bsb: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These were the sons of Shimei—four in all.
translations.kjv: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
translations.asv: And the sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
